title: The Girl Without Hands (Mädchen ohne Hände)

keywords: the girl without hands (mädchen ohne hände)
full_text:
A poor miller unwittingly pledged whatever stood behind his mill to the devil, only to discover it was his pious daughter. Because she washed her hands in tears of pure prayer, the devil could not touch her and commanded her father to chop off her hands.

The maiden placed her bleeding stumps in God's hands and wandered into the royal orchard, where an angel guided her to eat pears.

The king fell in love with her gentle purity, married her, and gave her silver hands.

When war took the king away, the devil intercepted their letters, banishing the queen and her child. An angel sheltered them in a forest hermitage for seven years, where her natural hands grew back through prayer and patience!

The king searched the world, found his true bride whole and radiant, and brought her home in everlasting joy.
moral: Purity of soul cannot be corrupted; divine grace restores what cruelty took away.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
